purpose: Define mandatory ethical standards, rights protections, and constitutional safeguards for all municipal actors and systems within the Munisible Task Force.

constitutional_protections.description: Safeguards ensuring all municipal actions comply with constitutional rights.

safeguards.name: Due Process Guarantee
safeguards.requirement: All civilians must receive fair, transparent, and rights-centered procedures.

safeguards.name: Unlawful Detention Prohibition
safeguards.requirement: No civilian may be detained without lawful authority and documented justification.

safeguards.name: Search & Seizure Safeguard
safeguards.requirement: All searches must follow constitutional standards and be fully documented.

ethical_conduct_standards.description: Defines ethical behavior requirements for all municipal actors.

safeguards.name: Respect & Dignity Mandate
safeguards.requirement: All civilians must be treated with inherent dignity regardless of circumstance.

safeguards.name: Non-Coercion Rule
safeguards.requirement: Coercive tactics are prohibited except in life-threatening emergencies.

safeguards.name: Anti-Retaliation Standard
safeguards.requirement: No municipal actor may retaliate against civilians for complaints or reports.

rights_impact_prevention.description: Safeguards preventing municipal actions that may harm civilian rights.

safeguards.name: Rights Impact Assessment
safeguards.requirement: All high-risk actions must undergo rights-impact evaluation.

safeguards.name: Disproportionate Impact Prevention
safeguards.requirement: Actions must not disproportionately affect vulnerable populations.

safeguards.name: Civilian Autonomy Protection
safeguards.requirement: Civilians must be given choices whenever possible to preserve autonomy.

trauma_prevention_safeguards.description: Ensures municipal actions minimize psychological and emotional harm.

safeguards.name: Trauma-Informed Engagement
safeguards.requirement: All interactions must follow trauma-preventive communication standards.

safeguards.name: Force Avoidance Mandate
safeguards.requirement: Force may only be used to prevent imminent loss of life.

safeguards.name: Emotional State Consideration
safeguards.requirement: Municipal actors must consider emotional and psychological state before acting.

vulnerable_population_protections.description: Enhanced safeguards for individuals at higher risk of harm.

safeguards.name: Youth Protection Standard
safeguards.requirement: All interactions with minors must follow youth-safe engagement protocols.

safeguards.name: Disability Accommodation Requirement
safeguards.requirement: Municipal actors must provide reasonable accommodations for disabilities.

safeguards.name: Marginalized Group Safeguard
safeguards.requirement: Enhanced protections apply to groups historically harmed by municipal systems.

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification and authority classification.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Required for ethical evaluation and rights-impact scoring.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Required for pattern detection and risk analysis.
